race.comment: PRECISE STAR (6) is the obvious top pick with four straight wins to launch the prep. Form is impossible to knock and he's still getting better. Can make it five straight. NORTH POLE (1) is hard to ignore after consecutive narrow seconds. Sets up well under the 3kg claim, though the draw is sticky. MAKE A CALL (3) tackles a more suitable trip off a month in-between and shoulders peaks that are competitive. Not taking lightly. ROCK HARD LOVE (4) had excuses last start when slow to recover but his prior form stacks up.
